title: Retail Analytics Dashboard
shortDescription: Interactive sales performance dashboard for a national retail chain
fullDescription: Designed and implemented a comprehensive retail analytics solution that transformed raw sales data into actionable insights. The dashboard provides real-time monitoring of KPIs, sales trends, and inventory levels across 200+ stores nationwide.
technicalApproach: Built using Power BI with direct connection to Azure SQL Data Warehouse. Created custom DAX measures for complex calculations and implemented row-level security to ensure regional managers only see relevant data. Used Power Query for ETL processes and data cleaning.
keyAchievements: Reduced monthly reporting time by 75% (from 4 days to 1 day)
Enabled data-driven inventory decisions that increased inventory turnover by 15%
Identified underperforming product categories leading to $1.2M in cost savings
Automated daily data refresh processes with incremental loading

title: Healthcare Metrics Platform
shortDescription: Patient outcomes and operational efficiency tracker for hospital network
fullDescription: Created a comprehensive healthcare analytics platform for a network of 12 hospitals to monitor patient outcomes, operational efficiency, and resource utilization. The solution integrated data from EHR systems, billing, and staffing to provide a 360-degree view of performance.
technicalApproach: Utilized Tableau for visualization layer connected to a PostgreSQL database. Implemented complex SQL queries for metrics calculations. Designed automated ETL processes using Python to standardize and clean data from multiple sources.
keyAchievements: Reduced average patient wait times by 22% through better resource allocation
Identified $3.5M in potential billing improvements through analysis of insurance claim patterns
Created automated anomaly detection for unusual patient outcome patterns
Implemented predictive model for patient admission forecasting with 87% accuracy

title: Financial Services KPI Tracker
shortDescription: Executive dashboard for monitoring financial performance metrics
fullDescription: Developed an executive-level dashboard for a financial services company to track key performance indicators across investment portfolios, customer acquisition, and operational efficiency. The solution provides both high-level summaries and drill-down capabilities for detailed analysis.
technicalApproach: Built using a combination of Tableau and R for statistical analysis. Implemented custom R scripts within Tableau for advanced forecasting. Created secure data pipeline from multiple sources including Salesforce, internal databases, and market data APIs.
keyAchievements: Consolidated 15+ disparate reports into a single source of truth
Improved investment decision-making speed by providing real-time market correlation analysis
Created portfolio risk score calculation that identified $12M in high-risk investments
Automated weekly executive reports that previously required 20+ hours of manual work

title: Supply Chain Optimization Tool
shortDescription: End-to-end supply chain visibility and optimization platform
fullDescription: Designed and implemented an end-to-end supply chain analytics solution for a manufacturing company with global operations. The platform provides visibility into inventory levels, production efficiency, logistics performance, and supplier reliability.
technicalApproach: Created using Power BI with DirectQuery to SQL Server. Implemented geospatial visualizations for logistics route optimization. Used Python integration for predictive modeling of inventory needs and potential supply chain disruptions.
keyAchievements: Reduced excess inventory by 18% through better demand forecasting
Identified and resolved bottlenecks in production process, increasing throughput by 12%
Optimized shipping routes resulting in $750K annual savings in logistics costs
Created supplier scorecard that improved on-time delivery rates by 15%
